pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Open WebUI is a self-hosted, extensible chat interface for local and remote LLM backends (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and others), with support for retrieval-augmented generation, tool/plugin integrations, and multiple vector-database and storage backends.
This package installs the official prebuilt PyPI wheel (which already bundles the compiled Svelte/Vite frontend) together with its full pinned runtime dependency closure, vendored as individual files.pythonhosted.org wheels -- see scripts/generate-open-webui-wheel-deps.py. No compilation or network access happens at build time.
